classes.name: Nitrogen Deficiency
classes.description: General uniform yellowing/chlorosis beginning on older foliage, stunted vegetative vigor.
classes.fertilizer: Urea (46-0-0) 2% foliar spray or Calcium Ammonium Nitrate (CAN) 40 kg/acre.
classes.organic: Enriched vermicompost (2 tons/acre) and liquid jeevamrutha foliar drench.

classes.name: Phosphorus Deficiency
classes.description: Foliage turns abnormally dark green with bronze/purple discoloration, delayed flowering.
classes.fertilizer: Single Super Phosphate (SSP 16%) 50 kg/acre or DAP (18-46-0) at root zone.
classes.organic: Rock phosphate combined with phosphate solubilizing bacteria (PSB 2 kg/acre).

classes.name: Potassium Deficiency
classes.description: Marginal chlorosis leading to scorch and necrosis along leaf margins, upward curling.
classes.fertilizer: Sulphate of Potash (SOP 0-0-50) 10 g/L foliar spray or Muriate of Potash (MOP 0-0-60).
classes.organic: Wood ash (100 kg/acre) or composted banana waste and potassium mobilizer (KMB).

classes.name: Magnesium Deficiency
classes.description: Distinct interveinal chlorosis on lower mature leaves, veins remain strikingly green.
classes.fertilizer: Magnesium Sulphate (Epsom salt, MgSO4) 5 g/L foliar spray applied twice at 10-day intervals.
classes.organic: Dolomite lime application (150 kg/acre) during field preparation.

classes.name: Iron Deficiency
classes.description: Interveinal chlorosis on youngest terminal leaves; leaf tissue bleaches to ivory/yellow.
classes.fertilizer: Chelated Iron (Fe-EDTA 12%) 1.0-1.5 g/L foliar spray early morning.
classes.organic: Fermented compost tea enriched with organic iron humate.

classes.name: Zinc Deficiency
classes.description: Little leaf / rosette symptom, shortening of internodes, mottled interveinal chlorosis.
classes.fertilizer: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate (ZnSO4 21%) 5 g/L neutralized with 2.5 g/L lime.
classes.organic: Zinc solubilizing biofertilizer (ZSB) seed treatment and zinc-enriched farmyard manure.

classes.name: Calcium Deficiency
classes.description: Deformed young leaves, hooked leaf tips, blossom end necrosis on fruiting vegetables.
classes.fertilizer: Calcium Nitrate (Ca(NO3)2) 5 g/L foliar spray during vegetative and flowering stage.
classes.organic: Crushed agricultural gypsum or bone meal powder.

classes.name: Boron Deficiency
classes.description: Thick, brittle foliage, curling downward, death of apical growing points.
classes.fertilizer: Solubor / Borax (20% B) 1.0 g/L foliar spray.
classes.organic: Composted poultry manure with organic boron amendments.

classes.name: Healthy Foliage (Balanced Nutrients)
classes.description: Uniform green pigmentation, balanced leaf expansion, optimal cell wall integrity.
classes.organic: Maintain regular vermicompost and microbial consortia maintenance.
